assumptions: USD million, thousand tests. Fictional Meadow Lab. Toy compare laboratory processing options with equal clinical validity stipulated.

evidence.text: [Demand] Annual test volume120k; low scenario90k. Same reimbursement regardless option.
[Internal] Variable $12/test, avoidable lab fixed cost1m. Shared administration .3m unavoidable.
[Outsource] Vendor $20/test, sample transport$2/test, transition cost .15m first year. Lab fixed avoided.
[Decision] Compare first-year relevant cost; no quality or patient outcome inference.

qas.question: Chi phí nội bộ tại 120k xét nghiệm, trước shared admin?
Chi phí outsource năm đầu tại 120k?
Lợi thế chi phí internal ở base?
Chi phí nội bộ tại low90k?
Chi phí outsource tại low90k?
Sản lượng hòa điểm năm đầu, nghìn tests?
Tại sao common admin .3 không phải khoản tiết kiệm khi outsource?
qas.answer: Nó không tránh được trong cả hai phương án; so sánh relevant cost loại phần chung.

qas.question: Có kết luận internal tốt hơn về y khoa vì chi phí thấp hơn?
qas.answer: Không. Chất lượng chỉ được giả định bằng nhau; thiếu đánh giá lâm sàng.

assumptions: USD million; thousand parcels. Fictional Birch Parcel. Toy automation reduces variable cost, adds fixed cost.

evidence.text: [Manual] Annual volume500k, variable $3/parcel, fixed warehouse cost .8m.
[Automated] Variable $1.5/parcel, existing fixed .8m remains, additional maintenance .25m; upfront investment2m.
[Value] Five-year annuity factor3.8, no salvage/tax. Volume constant in base.
[Stress] Annual volume350k, same unit costs. No change in quality or service level.

qas.question: Chi phí manual hàng năm ở 500k parcels?
Chi phí automated hàng năm trước đầu tư?
Annual cash saving at base?
NPV automation under base factor?
NPV under volume350k?
Annual volume for zero NPV, thousand parcels?
Có gọi .8 existing warehouse fixed cost là saving?
qas.answer: Không. Nó vẫn tồn tại sau automation.

qas.question: Có tính actual labor reduction from variable saving?
qas.answer: Không. Variable cost includes unspecified components, no worker count or hours.

assumptions: USD million. Fictional Pine Signal. Toy choose network ownership or sharing, equal coverage service.

evidence.text: [Owned] New site capex30 upfront, annual opex5, terminal salvage5 at year4.
[Share] Upfront integration4, annual fee9, no salvage. Same coverage and revenue.
[PV] Four-year annuity factor3.2, terminal factor .7; no tax.
[Budget] Upfront cap20. No finance available.

qas.question: PV cost ownership after salvage?
PV cost network sharing?
PV saving sharing versus owning?
Own-site funding gap versus cap?
Maximum annual sharing fee equal to owned PV cost?
Remaining budget if sharing selected?
Có xem annual fee9 expensive hơn opex5 nên own site tốt hơn?
qas.answer: Không. Phải tính upfront and terminal; sharing PV lower and feasible.

qas.question: Có xác định service reliability of partner network?
qas.answer: Không. Equal coverage is assumed; outage, SLA and capacity quality data absent.

assumptions: USD million; fictional Cedar Air. Toy single route annualized over identical flights. Compare booking policy expected contribution; passenger rights and actual legal rules not modeled.

evidence.text: [Flight] 100 seats, fare $200, variable passenger service cost $40 per boarded passenger. Fixed flight cost same.
[Policy A] Sell100 tickets; 90 show with probability .5, 100 show .5. All fares nonrefundable.
[Policy B] Sell105 tickets; 95 show with probability .5, 105 show .5. Max board100; denied boarding compensation$500/person. All fares collected.
[Decision] Choose higher expected contribution, subject to expected denied boarding ≤2 passengers per flight.

qas.question: Expected boarded passengers under A?
Expected boarded passengers under B?
Expected denied boarding under B?
Expected contribution per flight A?
Expected contribution per flight B including compensation?
Expected contribution difference B minus A?
Chọn B vì bán thêm5 tickets có hợp lý không?
qas.answer: Không. Expected contribution thấp hơn và denied2,5>2 constraint.

qas.question: Có suy ra actual compensation obligations for passengers?
qas.answer: Không. Toy compensation giả định, thiếu jurisdiction, contract and passenger circumstances.

assumptions: USD million; thousand hectares and million m³. Fictional Willow Field. Toy water shortage and optional purchased quota.

evidence.text: [Crops] A contribution $900/ha after normal costs, water4,000m³/ha, demand cap2k ha. B $600/ha, water2,000m³/ha, cap3k ha.
[Resources] Land4k ha, water8m m³. Continuous planning. No minimum crop acreage.
[Purchase] Can buy additional2m m³ block for .3m, no other effect. No other expansion.
[Policy] Maximize annual contribution net of quota cost. Common overhead unchanged.

qas.question: Contribution mỗi m³ của A?
Contribution mỗi m³ của B?
Base allocation after max B3k and remaining water?
Optimal contribution with extra2m water before purchase cost?
Net incremental benefit of purchased block?
Maximum acceptable price for quota block?
Vì sao không trồng A trước vì margin/ha900 cao hơn B600?
qas.answer: Water binds; B has higher contribution per m³, and chosen mix meets both constraints.

qas.question: Có biết actual water rights price next year?
qas.answer: Không. Stated offer only, future supply/rules absent.

assumptions: USD million. Fictional Fern Academy. Toy discrete additional evening cohort options.

evidence.text: [A] 200 students, fee$4k each, variable cost$2k, requires400 room-hours. Fixed launch cost .12m.

qas.question: Có xác định student learning outcome with evening programs?
qas.answer: Không. No educational outcome or student selection data.
